independence.method: Derive each finite bound from the checked Source signatures, actual extends/M12 authority, source expressions and R01/Q9. Compute IDs from the documented identity interface. Prior oracle is used solely to cross-check callable identities; its reached/fixed bound, domain, ABI and root values are not imported.
independence.role: Universal definition parameter bounds are representation contracts, never a runtime allocation, invocation or reached instance. This file does not replace or widen the separate reached ledger.
independence.representationScope: byteSize/alignment describe only the current canonical native byte plane, with referenceCount as a separate active-reference-plane bound. Zero byteSize on a Handle carrier never means zero whole machine ABI size. No platform call-convention, whole C++/wire/Runtime/VM qualification is claimed.
independence.noProfileRestriction: These are seven separate actual Source compilation closures. Exact expected domains for their 22 definitions do not restrict other legal Array<T>/class/union inputs or define a new admitted finite profile.
independence.boundRole: Expected v9 definition representation maxima, not a minimal set of operationally reached values. In particular, the fixed conservative shared-owner element closure is separate from per-path array memory optimization; this artifact does not infer a tighter published ABI from a reached call or literal.

comparison.noResult: result:null iff ordinary void or construction-body; an undefined/null value is a non-null actual domain with an absence alternative.
comparison.extraRootsPolicy: Readonly static permission never deep-freezes a Heap. Unrelated structural actuals require the real same-origin selected M12 entry authority; constructor/method implementation receivers use only their actual nominal implementation/descendants.

identities.canonicalJSON: UTF-8; object keys ordinal sorted; no whitespace or trailing LF in identity payloads.

comparison.slotLookup: parameters[].domainId and row.result resolve in domains[].domainId; elementDomainId is the related owner element bound, not an ABI argument.
comparison.absencePolicy: A value undefined/null is a domain alternative; no-result is null only at row.result/abi.result. Not-defined and definedUndefined require distinct field state and are never inferred equal from a union storage bound. The Pair n/child fields here are required fields initialized to undefined, not optional-property existence coverage.
comparison.activeReferenceRule: referenceCount is a maximum. Only references active under the actual selected union/nested-value tags are live edges; an initialized undefined alternative contributes no inactive reference/native payload.
